decision: Reject the existing terminal-prefill route on the unchanged current stack. First token144 and logit10.375 match, but462 of512 continuation IDs differ starting at output1 (expected255, actual244). Original prompt and every actual callback are present and host guards pass. The23890.0486ms TTFT cannot be retained. The route changes final-layer projection, normalization, gating, MoE and cache inputs together; this run does not isolate the first incorrect intermediate. Later Q1 decode fixes do not repair all terminal-prefill arithmetic. Next test retains the qualified full-prefix QKV/KV production and cache capture and removes only unused terminal-layer attention queries under an explicit single-last-row consumer scope.
